Replying to @legendaryxmedia 🍪 WHERE I ORDER MY CUSTOM COOKIE BAGS! I order my custom cookie bags from Anhui Magic Packaging Co., Ltd. on Alibaba. Here’s how to get started: 1. Click the vendor link below to visit their Alibaba store. 2. Select “Chat Now” to contact the supplier directly. 3. Let them know you’re interested in custom-printed cookie bags for your bakery. 4. Send them your logo, brand colors, preferred bag dimensions, and any design inspiration you have. 5. Ask about their minimum order quantity (MOQ), pricing, production time, and shipping costs. 6. Always request a sample before placing a large order! This allows you to check the material, printing quality, and overall appearance. ✨ MY ADVICE: Don’t be afraid to ask questions! Make sure you know exactly what you’re purchasing, including whether the bags are food-safe and suitable for your cookies. Remember, presentation matters! Stop paying sales tax on your Alibaba inventory 👀 If you have a seller's permit (also called a resale certificate or sales tax permit), you can upload it to your Alibaba.com account and qualify for tax exempt purchases on products you plan to resell. 💸 Here's how: 1️⃣ Log into your Alibaba account 2️⃣ Go to your account settings and find Tax Information 3️⃣ Upload your seller's permit or resale certificate 4️⃣ Wait for approval, then shop wholesale tax free on qualifying orders This is one of the easiest ways to protect your profit margins when sourcing wholesale products from China for your boutique, online store, or reselling business.
